podcast.title: Joining Arcade Fire (Pre-Neon Bible)
podcast.body: Jeremy Gara joined Arcade Fire as the drummer during the period leading up to the recording of their second album, *Neon Bible*, becoming a key new member. "Two new members joined up, drummer Jeremy Garam"
